name: 11702 · Babylon, NY
findings: ZIP 11702 (Babylon) has 58 nonprofit organizations. 28 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 23 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 11702 (Babylon) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 11702 (Babylon) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).
